content.text: Resubmitted with the duration expressed in numerals ("12 months") so the numeric duration check resolves, and the comment conformed to match. All other aspects of the fallback proposal are unchanged: mutuality retained as already met, scope narrowed to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12-month tail from the end of involvement, and general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs added, with no no-hire component and no extraneous terms.
